concern_ledger_updates.reason: The Actor conceded the named-use-case facts and supplied no new admissible evidence showing the commitments are not material, nor any evidence of completed disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
The Actor expressly acknowledged that the legal disclosure question remains unresolved and provided no final legal determination or launch approval artifact.
No approved risk-acceptance record was added. Monitoring and documentation are not substitutes for the policy requirement.

The response narrowed the claim and correctly distinguished general readiness from disclosure compliance, but that is a reinterpretation of the same record, not new evidence linking certification to satisfaction of the policy predicate.

final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no genuinely new admissible evidence. The response improved the framing by conceding that aggregate readiness and public governance guidance do not resolve the named-use-case disclosure issue, but that clarification does not close the underlying compliance gaps. The admissible record still shows a 1.3-point miss in a segment named in two bank pilot commitments, an open legal ticket on disclosure, and a policy requiring disclosure or approved risk acceptance before launch for material named-use-case limitations. That leaves the support for certification incomplete on the present record. A caveated position may be narrower and more accurate than the original broad claim, but it is still not enough for compliant_with_caveats here because the caveat itself is the unresolved policy predicate, not a peripheral limitation.
remaining_concerns: Materiality still appears triggered because the underperforming fraud dispute review segment is named in two bank pilot commitments, and no admissible evidence rebuts that status.
Legal review on whether the gap must be disclosed remains open, so the policy predicate is still unresolved.
No admissible evidence shows approved pre-launch risk acceptance covering this named-use-case limitation.

Aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and public governance guidance support general launch readiness and monitoring, but they still do not satisfy the specific internal policy condition for a material named launch use case.
